knowledge.name: Water uses 水的用途
knowledge.explanation: water plants、cook food、wash clothes、produce electricity，水在生活与生产中的用途是课文的主要内容。

knowledge.name: be used to do 被动语态初步
knowledge.explanation: Water is used to produce electricity. = Water is used for producing electricity. be used to do 与 be used for doing 可互换。

knowledge.name: should must 节水建议
knowledge.explanation: should 表「应该」（建议），must 表「必须」（强制）；两者后都接动词原形。
prerequisites: be used to do 被动语态初步

knowledge.name: Quantity words 数量表达
knowledge.explanation: a lot of 许多、a little 一点（不可数）、enough 足够；不可数名词 water 不能直接加 a/an。

options: Water is used to produce electricity.
questions.analysis: 被动语态 be used to do 结构，A 正确；B 缺 to，C 主动语态且缺 is，D 缺 be 动词。
questions.knowledge_point: be used to do 被动语态初步

questions.stem: We should （  ） water when we brush our teeth.
questions.analysis: should 后接动词原形，用 save；saves 是第三人称单数，saved 是过去式，saving 是动名词。

questions.stem: The water in the river is not clean （  ） to drink. （填「足够」）
questions.analysis: 「足够干净可以喝」用 clean enough；enough 修饰形容词时放在其后。

questions.stem: Water is used for cooking. 和 Water is used to cook. 意思基本相同。
questions.analysis: be used for doing 与 be used to do 都表示用途，可互换，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: be used to do 被动语态初步

questions.stem: 下面哪句表达「我们必须节约用水」？（  ）
questions.analysis: must 后直接接动词原形，A 正确；B 多了 to，C 用了动名词，D must 不加 s。

questions.stem: Farmers use water to （  ） （water） the plants.
questions.analysis: use sth to do sth 中 to 后接动词原形，water 作动词表示「浇灌」，所以填 water。

questions.stem: 下列属于水在生活中的用途的有（  ）
questions.analysis: A 做饭 ✓；B 洗衣服 ✓；C 浇植物 ✓；D 造纸币需要水但「制币」不是本单元列举的生活用途，且说法不严谨 ✗。故 A、B、C 成立，D 不成立。

questions.stem: should 表示比 must 更强制的要求。
questions.analysis: must 语气更强，表示「必须」；should 表示建议「应该」，强度弱于 must，说法错误。

options: There is a little water in the bottle.
There is a few water in the bottle.
There are a little water in the bottle.
There is many water in the bottle.
questions.analysis: water 不可数，用 a little 修饰且 be 动词用 is，A 正确；B a few 只修饰可数复数，C are 与不可数不符，D many 只修饰可数复数。

questions.stem: Water （  ） （use） to make paper in that factory.
questions.analysis: 主语 water 是动作承受者，用被动语态 is used；写 uses 则语态错误。
questions.knowledge_point: be used to do 被动语态初步

questions.stem: 关于本单元语法，说法正确的有（  ）
options: be used to do 表示「被用来做」
a little 修饰不可数名词
questions.analysis: A be used to do 表用途 ✓；B should + 原形 ✓；C must 后应接动词原形，不是动名词 ✗；D a little 修饰不可数 ✓。故 A、B、D 成立，C 不成立。
questions.knowledge_point: be used to do 被动语态初步

questions.stem: We should not waste water. 是否定建议句，意思是「我们不应该浪费水」。
questions.analysis: should not 表示「不应该」，整句意为不应浪费水，说法正确。

questions.stem: 「水足够热，可以洗澡」的英文是（  ）
options: The water is hot enough to take a shower.
The water is enough hot to take a shower.
The water is hot enough taking a shower.
The water enough is hot to take a shower.
questions.analysis: enough 修饰形容词要后置：hot enough，后接 to do，A 正确；B 位置错，C 缺 to，D 语序错。

questions.stem: We can save water by （  ） （turn） off the tap.
questions.analysis: by 表示方式，后接动名词，turn 变 turning；写 turn 则介词后缺 -ing。

questions.stem: water 是可数名词，可以说 a water。
questions.analysis: water 通常作不可数名词，不能直接加 a/an；表「一杯水」要说 a glass of water。

questions.stem: 用英语写两句话说明水的用途，要求用上 be used to do 结构。

answer.value: Water is used to cook food. It is also used to produce electricity.

questions.analysis: 参考示例见答案。评分要点：①两句都用被动结构 be used to do（2 分）；②用途表述合理（1 分）；③主谓一致（1 分）；④大小写与标点（1 分）。写成 Water uses to cook 不得分。
questions.knowledge_point: be used to do 被动语态初步

questions.stem: 把句子补全并译成中文：We （  ） （should / must） save every drop of water, because clean water is not （  ） for everyone.

answer.value: should；enough。译文：我们应该节约每一滴水，因为对每个人来说干净的水并不够用。

questions.analysis: 参考答案：should（建议语气，符合倡议语境）；enough（be not enough 表示不够）。译文见答案。评分要点：①两空正确（2 分）；②译文准确（2 分）；③标点（1 分）。第二空填 enough 时注意位置在形容词之后。

questions.stem: 「这座工厂每天用掉大量水」的英文是（  ）
options: The factory uses a lot of water every day.
The factory uses many water every day.
The factory uses a lot water every day.
The factory use a lot of waters every day.
questions.analysis: a lot of 可修饰不可数名词，A 正确；B many 只修饰可数，C 缺 of，D 主语第三人称单数应用 uses 且 water 不加 s。
